scope: Actual official bytes copied once to private MinIO with admitted identity; WAV headers supply necessary native clocks, not a repeated integrity audit. Native staging/projection/commit and application readback are unsubstituted. All layers, unknown labels, source clocks and provenance retained. No inference or new download.

cases.admission_positive: All 84,295 admitted members plus original ZIP reach linked application assets with prior identities. Existing member reuse does not read supplied bytes.
cases.admission_negative: Interrupted storage writes do not create linked source files; unsafe new paths remain rejected by ordinary admission. No hash scan or download.
cases.normalization_positive: All speakers/transcripts/manual and automatic layers/media and native operation totals survive actual projection; all raw labels and boundaries stay linked to admitted source assets.
cases.normalization_negative: Bare S/D, uncertain err/* labels and automatic alignment never become invented manual errors/IPA. Unknown ancillary tiers retain native structure without invented semantics.
cases.resume_positive: Observe a real interrupted native import, reopen durable storage, resume cursor, and reach full normalized completion without duplicated or changed accepted rows/assets.
cases.resume_negative: Reject stale revisions without altering accepted data; cancellation or incomplete runs are not complete imports.
cases.readback_positive: Commit actual normalized records; source status/release/progress/records/media handlers return saved official data, clocks, source rights and origin.
cases.readback_negative: Official import must not claim suitcase auto layers or 24 suitcase speakers, fabricate error taxonomy/IPA, enable source transfer to models or affect ordinary preparation.

speaker_metadata: Actual official README.md was inspected for source speaker/L1/gender/table counts, not for byte integrity. Parse its documented speaker table, preserve original native row and document provenance, and join declared L1 to transcripts. No nationality/accent inference.
